subject: general
question: Who among the following was involved in Alipore Bomb Case?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sri Aurobindo__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sri Aurobindo was arrested in the aftermath of a number of bomb outrages linked to his organization in a public trial where he faced charges of treason for the Alipore Conspiracy.
 
• Alipore Bomb Case, the Muraripukur conspiracy, or the Manicktolla bomb conspiracy, was a criminal case held in **India in 1908.**
 
• **Chittaranjan Das** successfully defended Aurobindo Ghosh on charges of involvement in the **Alipore bomb case.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ram Prasad Bismil** was an Indian poet, writer and revolutionary who participated in the Mainpuri Conspiracy of **1918**, and the Kakori Conspiracy of 1925, and fought against **British Raj**.
 
• **Bhagat Singh **was a charismatic Indian revolutionary who participated in the mistaken murder of a junior British police officer in what was to be retaliation for the death of an Indian nationalist.
 
• **Chandrasekhar Azad **was Indian revolutionary who **organized and led a band of militant youth during India's independence movement**.
